v0_1_preservation: historical; do not rewrite or reinterpret its completed artifacts
revision_reason: separate designed method fixtures from evaluative scientific experiments
remove hard-coded interpretive result states from generated outputs
make the plan the single source of parameter values
correct F6 implementation drift from the v0.1 parameter list
strengthen noise-entry controls with a no-noise physical baseline and multiple fixed seeds
expand second-order chi admission checks beyond the chi=1 fixture and refuse negative damping as a damping-ratio chi
claim_ceiling: method qualification and exploratory architecture analysis only

anti_circularity.designed_fixture_rule: F0-F8 are deliberately constructed known-truth fixtures. Recovery of their built-in behavior validates implementation only and cannot confirm chi architecture, compensation, cross-regime transportability, or ADDS.
anti_circularity.parameter_single_source: all runner parameter values must be read from this plan; duplicated hidden parameter lists are forbidden
anti_circularity.raw_output_rule: F0-F6 result records contain measured/native quantities, not hard-coded scientific interpretation labels
anti_circularity.interpretation_rule: scientific classifications beyond exact mathematical refusal/admission are assigned only by a separately versioned evaluation rule
anti_circularity.outcome_independence: future evaluative targets must be defined independently of the S/M/C/R quantities claimed to explain them
anti_circularity.no_retuning: after a result is viewed, changing parameters, metrics, mappings, thresholds, or labels starts a new version and preserves the prior outcome
anti_circularity.no_scalar_mining: no scalar may be called chi because it was selected for favorable association with an already-viewed architecture or target
anti_circularity.fixture_to_evidence_prohibition: a behavior intentionally encoded into a fixture may not be counted as evidence that the corresponding general hypothesis is true
anti_circularity.future_evaluative_split: before a P1 claim, freeze discovery/calibration/untouched-holdout separation under a complete MFR-14; F0-F8 cannot serve as the untouched holdout

parameter_provenance_classes.ANALYTIC_FIXTURE: chosen from known native mathematics to exercise a specific branch; implementation evidence only
parameter_provenance_classes.STRUCTURAL_SWEEP: chosen prospectively to vary one declared construction axis while retaining all cases
parameter_provenance_classes.FIXED_SEED_SET: seed set fixed for robustness and all seeds retained; no seed may be discarded for an unfavorable outcome
parameter_provenance_classes.FUTURE_UNTOUCHED: not present in F0-F8; requires a later freeze before target reveal

chi_policy.negative_gamma_rule: negative gamma is active antidamping and is not admitted here as a damping-ratio chi

representation_policy.S: named scalar representation derived from the native model
representation_policy.M: named vector/modal/subspace representation derived from the native model
representation_policy.C: named interaction/coupling/system representation; never arbitrary feature concatenation
representation_policy.R: cross-representation relationship diagnostics; not automatically a chi component
representation_policy.U: uncertainty, residuals, conditioning, refusal, and nonidentifiability

families.name: normal_decoupled_baseline
families.primary_task: verify the implementation does not require extra architecture where eigenvalue stability is sufficient

families.name: same_spectrum_different_modal_geometry
families.invariant: eigenvalues are exactly {-1,-2} for every k
families.primary_task: measure maximum finite-time two-norm gain on the fixed grid
families.native_comparator_candidate: largest singular value of exp(A t)

families.name: same_modal_geometry_different_scalar_spectrum
families.invariant: canonical coordinate basis is the modal basis
families.primary_task: compare state norm at the fixed evaluation time

families.name: same_local_subsystems_different_coupling
families.primary_task: verify that whole-system behavior can depend on coupling while isolated local terms are fixed

families.name: feedback_stability_control
families.known_hurwitz_condition: trace=-0.7<0 and determinant=-0.3+k*h>0; stability requires k*h>0.3
families.primary_task: verify recovery of the native coupling-dependent stability criterion
families.prohibited_inference: these analytically selected cases do not establish compensatory discordance

families.name: noise_entry_point
families.governing_object: stable feedback state model plus observation model
families.primary_task: verify that observer-only noise leaves the physical trajectory equal to the no-noise control while process and feedback/sensor disturbances enter the physical state
families.native_comparator_candidate: known noise-injection path and state trajectory

families.name: nonnormal_transient_growth
families.primary_task: compare fixed-spectrum asymptotic stability with exact finite-time singular-value amplification
families.prohibited_inference: recovery of standard non-normal behavior does not by itself establish added architecture value

families.name: degenerate_subspace_refusal
families.native_truth: the full eigenspace is identifiable but individual eigenvectors are not unique
families.primary_task: verify refusal of unique individual-mode identity

families.name: chi_admission_and_refusal
families.primary_task: verify mathematically licensed scalar admission and explicit refusal without privileging chi=1 as the only positive case
